# Town & Country Electrical Co.

> Family-run, licensed and insured residential electrician based in Mullumbimby NSW 2482, servicing the entire Northern Rivers: Mullumbimby, Byron Bay, Brunswick Heads, Ocean Shores, Bangalow, Pottsville, Lennox Head, Ballina, Kingscliff, Lismore. Owner-operated by licensed electrician Jordan Giuffre. Upfront pricing, workmanship guaranteed, 24/7 emergency call-outs. Phone 0405 305 671. Email jordan@towncountryelectrical.com.au.
